title: Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS
Disorders of The Liver and Biliary Tract

blocks.text: Defined as steatotic liver disease (evidence by Imaging, blood markers or histology) in the presence of one or more cardiometabolic risk factors (Overweight /Obesity, Type II DM, HTN or Dyslipidemia) and the absence of harmful alcohol intake. The spectrum of MAFLD includes steatosis, metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH, previously NASH), fibrosis, cirrhosis and MASH-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).

blocks.text: A rational initial approach to treatment focuses on improving insulin sensitivity via diet, exercise and lifestyle modification, all patients should be advised to avoid alcohol.

blocks.text: Life style modification: Weight loss target ≥ 5% for steatosis, ≥ 7-10% for NASH & Fibrosis regression (Methods advised for weight loss are: Calorie deficit 500-1000kcal/day, Mediterranean or Low carbohydrate diet, Aerobic + resistance exercise (150-200min/week)
